Interface EventEmitterInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlwaysMouseOwner, BooleanSetting, Camera, CommandPaletteStep, Commands, ComplexSetting, DoubleClickStep, DoubleSetting, EnumSetting, EventEmitter, GCurve, GLine, GObject, GPoint, GTri, GuideFlow, GuideInfo, IntSetting, MouseOwner, NoMouseOwner, ObjectExplainerStep, OrbitMouseOwner, QTranslateMouseOwner, ReactivePoint, RotateMouseOwner, ScaleMouseOwner, SceneExplStep, SelectionMouseOwner, SelectionStep, Setting, SnapMouseOwner, StringSetting, TransformMouseOwner, TranslateMouseOwner, UIExplainerStep, WelcomeStep
public interface EventEmitterInterface
EventEmitterInterface is an interface that allows for other classes to attach events that they can broadcast to at any time. This is available for classes that cannot extend EventEmitter `but still want to have event broadcasting capabilities.
